activities_reminder_idx.name: activities_reminder_idx
activities_reminder_idx.where: "activities"."completed_at" is null and "activities"."cancelled_at" is null and "activities"."reminded_at" is null

activities_scheduled_or_done.name: activities_scheduled_or_done
activities_scheduled_or_done.value: "activities"."due_at" is not null or "activities"."completed_at" is not null

activities_done_or_cancelled.name: activities_done_or_cancelled
activities_done_or_cancelled.value: not ("activities"."completed_at" is not null and "activities"."cancelled_at" is not null)

credit_profiles_hold_complete.name: credit_profiles_hold_complete
credit_profiles_hold_complete.value: ("credit_profiles"."hold_reason" is null) = ("credit_profiles"."held_at" is null) and ("credit_profiles"."held_at" is null) = ("credit_profiles"."held_by_member_id" is null)

product_variants_price_within_mrp.name: product_variants_price_within_mrp
product_variants_price_within_mrp.value: "product_variants"."selling_price_paise" is null or "product_variants"."mrp_paise" is null or "product_variants"."selling_price_paise" <= "product_variants"."mrp_paise"

stock_ledger_quantity_sign.name: stock_ledger_quantity_sign
stock_ledger_quantity_sign.value:
case
        when "stock_ledger"."movement_type" in ('opening', 'purchase_receipt', 'transfer_in', 'sale_return') then "stock_ledger"."quantity" > 0
        when "stock_ledger"."movement_type" in ('purchase_return', 'transfer_out', 'sale', 'damage') then "stock_ledger"."quantity" < 0
        else "stock_ledger"."quantity" <> 0
      end

support_grants_one_decision.name: support_grants_one_decision
support_grants_one_decision.value: not ("support_grants"."approved_at" is not null and "support_grants"."declined_at" is not null)

users_tenant_select.name: users_tenant_select
users_tenant_select.using:
exists (
        select 1 from organization_members m
        where m.user_id = "users"."id" and m.organization_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_organization_id', true), '')::uuid
      )

users_phone_or_email.name: users_phone_or_email
users_phone_or_email.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null
